refnamediv.refpurpose: Remove cached extra-data from the local repository

refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: Removes embedded extra-data from commits in local Flatpak repositories. By default, all configured user and system installations are inspected. Writable installations are cleaned, while system installations that are not writable are reported without modification. Use --user, --system, or --installation to limit the command to selected installations.

It also removes incomplete .part downloads and interrupted prefetch directories from the per-user extra-data directory. Other files in that directory are reported and left unchanged. The per-user directory is not inspected when only system installations are selected.

Leftovers that Flatpak itself does not remove are cleaned as well: empty directories that deleted refs and remotes leave under repo/refs, checkouts of deployments that were interrupted, partial-commit markers of commits that no longer exist, and -origin remotes of bundles whose apps are no longer installed.

The data of apps that are no longer installed in any installation (~/.var/app/ID and per-user overrides) is listed, and only deleted with --delete-data, which also resets the app's portal permissions.

Writable repositories are locked exclusively while they are inspected and modified. Cleaning an explicitly selected system installation requires direct write access to its repository and does not use the Flatpak system helper.
